Welcome
Your home away from home in North Conway
Located in the heart of North Conway, NH, we are conveniently located just a short distance from over 100 premium outlet stores. We are within a few minutes to great restaurants and ski areas, and centrally located to White Mountain attractions. We offer clean, comfortable, and always affordable lodging. Children are always welcome — our rooms are tastefully decorated and recently renovated. We look forward to meeting you and your family, and offer friendly advice to help make your stay here a memorable one.

About the Area | Briarcliff Motel North Conway | Briarcliff Motel
Skip to content
About the area
In   the   heart   of   the   Mt.   Washington   Valley
Book Now Get Directions
Scroll to explore
Mt. Washington Valley
Centrally located in the heart of the Valley
Briarcliff Motel is centrally located in the heart of the Mt. Washington Valley — attractions, restaurants, shops, and four-season recreation are all within a short drive.
Dining & shopping
Easy to fill a trip without overplanning
Main Street restaurants walkable from town, plus outlet shopping and locally owned shops a few minutes out.
Main Street dining in North Conway
Premium outlets and local shops
Pairs naturally with attraction and ski days
Winter focus
Ski country within reach
A strong base camp for winter trips — Cranmore, Attitash, and the wider White Mountains lineup.
Attitash Mountain Resort
Cranmore Mountain Resort
Eight alpine mountains within a half-hour drive
Four cross-country areas with grooming and rentals
Nearby attractions
Places worth a visit
The anchor stops that shape a White Mountains trip.
Attitash Mountain Resort
Alpine skiing and summer adventure — 20 minutes away in Bartlett.
Wildcat Mountain
Sweeping Mt. Washington views across Pinkham Notch — a classic NH ski area.
Black Mountain
A relaxed, family-friendly Jackson ski area, a short drive north.
Cranmore Mountain Resort
The local ski hill — five minutes from the front desk.
Mt. Washington Auto Road
Drive to the Northeast s highest summit on the historic carriage road.
Mount Washington Cog Railway
Climb the mountain by historic cog train — a White Mountains classic.
Conway Scenic Railroad
Vintage scenic rail from North Conway station — foliage season highlight.
Story Land
Fairy-tale theme park in Glen — a favorite for families with young kids.
Santa s Village
Christmas-themed park in Jefferson with rides, reindeer, and holiday cheer.
Summer recreation
Warm-weather days in the Valley
A broad mix, not a single trip style.
Biking
Road, mountain, and fat biking on Valley trails.
Canoeing & kayaking
Rentals, guides, and countless waterways to paddle.
Fishing
Fly-fishing on mountain brooks and rivers (NH permit required).
Golf
Five scenic PGA courses within a short drive.
Hiking
White Mountain National Forest trails for every level — guided trips available.
Horseback riding
Rides at Farm by the River, Attitash, and Bretton Woods.
Rock climbing
Indoor gyms and classic crags across the White Mountains.
Train rides
Scenic summer outings on the Conway Scenic and Cog railways.
Winter recreation
Beyond the ski lift
Skiing is central — but the Valley does more than that.
Skiing & snowboarding
Eight alpine mountains and four cross-country areas within a half-hour.
Snowmobiling
Rentals and groomed trail networks maintained by local clubs.
Snowshoeing
Trails throughout the White Mountain National Forest.
Sleigh rides
Horse-drawn sleighs at local ski areas and Nestlenook Farm.
Ice skating
Ham Arena and Nestlenook Farm — two classic local rinks.
Snow tubing
Tubing hills and rentals at several nearby ski areas.
Dog sledding
Runs with Muddy Paws Sled Dog Rescue — a local favorite.
